dataset.name: Soil Environmental Conditions in the East River Watershed, CO
description: This dataset contains depth-resolved soil environmental variables collected between June 2016 and October 2018 from the Bradley Meadow site in the East River watershed. Datalogger output from 7 Campbell CS655 12 cm Soil Moisture and Temperature Sensors including depth, temperature, volumetric water content, and electrical conductivity are included in ‘BM_Merged_T_VWC_0616_10_18.csv’. Sensors were installed in June 2016. Data have been processed to merge raw sensor data and to remove additional variables. No additional QA/QC was performed. Measured pCO2 and depth are contained in ‘BM_EGM_WELL_CO2.csv’. These data represent gas well samples measured via injection using a PP Systems EGM-5 infra-red gas analyzer as described in the methods section. Measured CO2 surface flux values are contained in 'BM_EGM_Surface_Flux.csv'. These were measured using the PP Systems EGM-5 with the Soil Respiration Chamber attachment. Multiple reps are reported for each measurement including CO2 flux rate calculations using built-in linear and quadratic function methods, and average and standard deviations are taken across all reps and calculation methods.

measurementTechnique: A nested gas well array was installed at the BM site consisting of 6 wells (stainless steel tubing w/ 60 μm mesh screen attached to the buried end and compression fittings on the surface end) in November, 2015. Each gas well was buried within a ~4 cm layer of carbonate-free sand between two layers of bentonite clay to limit vertical diffusion within the installation core hole. Gas samples were taken via gas-tight syringe by first evacuating 2x the tubing volume. We pulled 60 mL of gas sample, and injected 30 mL into a field-portable PP Systems EGM-5 IRGA unit. Sample pCO2 was recorded as the maximum measured value based on laboratory calibration.
